prompt:
Sandra flagged a collision on Las Vistas 9D to me because I handled the onsite side of that turn and was copied when Brooke handed the unit back to leasing. She has a second showing with prospect Catalina Reyes penciled in tomorrow morning, but a make-ready kickoff appeared ahead of it. I thought the turn was behind us, yet the final-QC trail is messy, and I don't want us to cancel genuine work or send Catalina into an active worksite. Can you reconstruct 9D's trail from move-out through the handoff to Sandra and determine whether anything afterward establishes a real new turnover?

Before either team arrives, please get the current property records back in line with what the evidence supports while keeping Brooke looped in. Treat the most recently updated current turn record as canonical, resolve any QC or maintenance follow-up that is still open after the underlying work was completed, and leave historical records alone. On the calendar, cancel the unsupported appointment rather than repurposing it, with cancellation notices sent to everyone listed on it. Create or retain the supported appointment with me, Sandra, and Catalina as attendees. If the showing is the supported appointment, leave an unsent confirmation email draft addressed to Catalina in my mailbox and include its proposed copy in your final note so I can review it with Sandra.

Post separate factual status updates in the leasing and make-ready channels, tagging Brooke for any cross-team direction, and add a note with the final showing details to Catalina's HubSpot contact. Open a prevention item on the Property Ops board for Brooke to own at the portfolio level; identify who actually created the unsupported calendar event rather than assuming its organizer did, document which completed scope it repeated, and recommend a check that would prevent that scope from being scheduled again. Please let me know the evidence you relied on and every current record, appointment, notification, and follow-up you changed.
